verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships AI features (Cortex AI Functions using third-party LLMs, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Code), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or contractual guarantee preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. Compliance certifications and Data Clean Rooms are adjacent privacy features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
